hero.question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
hero.prob_take:
The market is pricing Rubio at 12.4%, which means bettors are treating a Trump-endorsed establishment Republican with actual political capital as a 7-to-1 longshot in an open 2028 field. That's either efficiently skeptical or leaving value on the table, depending on whether Trump's coattails matter in a post-Trump primary.

The real tell: this market hasn't priced in that Rubio could be Secretary of State by then, giving him both foreign policy credibility and a megaphone for 4 years straight, which historically is worth more than 12.4% in an open primary.

The market is treating proximity to Trump as a guarantee of nomination support, which ignores decades of primary dynamics. Smart money is selling this bump hard. Rubio's actual path to 2028 is cluttered with stronger candidates, fresher names, and fewer natural constituencies than the market's 12.4% implies.
